nodes.label: notes.md engineering log
nodes.rationale: A running record of every non-obvious thing found or decided during development, kept explicitly so the reasoning can be retraced at the final oral presentation. It is the rationale source for most of the shader design.

nodes.label: One code path for static and moving shadow lights
nodes.rationale: Rejected splitting static torches onto push constants and only the held torch onto a UBO: the saving is a few hundred bytes of memcpy against 36 real geometry draws per light per frame, while the cost is a permanent second code path and a silent freeze-the-shadow trap for any light that later becomes movable.

nodes.label: Swap margin and reassign interval (anti-thrash)
nodes.rationale: A plain 'N nearest every tick' rule thrashes at a distance boundary and every flip forces a full shadow re-render, so a waiting candidate must be genuinely closer (SHADOW_SWAP_MARGIN 1.15) and the decision only re-runs every 0.3s.

nodes.label: CPU/GPU split of the lighting cheats
nodes.rationale: Which sources exist is a CPU question, answered by SceneLights simply not uploading a light so the shader's loop never learns anything was turned off; how a surviving light is shaded is a GPU question, answered by the debugFlags bits.

nodes.label: MGCG meshes average normals across hard edges
nodes.rationale: Every stair riser and flat wall panel shaded with a gradient instead of one constant value, because the exporter averaged vertex normals where E06 s.3-16 requires vertices duplicated per face. The fix is a per-material flag, never global, since the faceted towers want their averaged normals.
